Method of Attack: Attackers used a wide range of exploits to compromise CMS platforms (WordPress, Joomla, JBoss server) prior to launching command injection (CMDi) attacks that installed cryptocurrency mining tools hidden within fake image files using steganography.
Impacted Systems: CMS platforms: WordPress, Joomla, JBoss Application Servers
Attack Vector: Compromised web servers hosting fake image files
Indicators of Compromise: Fake image files containing mining tools
Compromised Joomla and WordPress web servers
